aaa_enabled.summary: Enable AAA authentication, then define methods before disconnecting.
aaa_enabled.notes: Enabling AAA changes login behaviour immediately. Configure a local fallback in the same session to avoid lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable telnet under the management telnet block.
secure_vty_transport.notes: EOS uses 'management telnet' and 'management ssh' blocks rather than 'line vty' transport input.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set an idle timeout of 10 minutes or less under management ssh.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Idle timeout is in minutes. Also consider setting it under 'management console'.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure a hashed enable secret and enable password encryption.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: EOS supports sha512 hashing for enable secrets. Remove any legacy enable password.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default community strings and replace with unique values.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Prefer SNMPv3 with authPriv over any v1/v2c community.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the HTTP protocol under management api http-commands.
http_server_disabled.notes: Use HTTPS only or disable the management API entirely with 'shutdown'.

ssh_version_2.summary: EOS 4.x enforces SSHv2 exclusively; verify by running 'show management ssh'.
ssh_version_2.notes: Arista EOS does not expose the SSH protocol version in configuration text. Modern EOS releases enforce SSHv2; confirm with 'show management ssh' output.

logging_enabled.summary: Enable logging to a local buffer and a remote syslog collector.
logging_enabled.notes: Configure both a local buffer and a remote syslog host for resilience.

management_acl.summary: Apply an inbound ACL to restrict SSH management access.
management_acl.notes: Verify your management IP is inside the permitted range before applying.

login_banner.summary: Set a login banner warning unauthorized users.
cli: Authorised access only. Activity is logged and monitored.
login_banner.notes: Do not include device details in the banner.

password_min_length.notes: Applies to passwords set after the command.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure at least two NTP time sources.
ntp_configured.notes: Two sources let the device detect a lying one.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Use SNMPv3 for write access instead of v2c communities.
